dialogue.conversations: Talk? Fine — first consultation's free, %1$s. After that we discuss rates.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Excellent week. Eggs are up, expenses are down, and the baker owes me two favors. The portfolio thrives.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Terrible margin this week — six days in, one decent soup out. Your asking, though... I'll book that as income.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Profitable. Found a nail, sold nothing at a loss, and the well water's still free. They'll fix that oversight someday.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: A net loss of a day. Dropped an egg — that's one whole egg — and lent the miller my ladder. I'll see neither again.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I love it. Every blister converts to bread eventually. Show me another investment with returns like that.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: The hours are theft and the pay is worse. I've done the math — I stay out of stubbornness, which at least costs nothing.
dialogue.conversations.life.first: The whole story? Premium inventory, %1$s. But you pay attention, and that's the rarest coin. Fine — chapter one, free of charge.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A pantry so full I could lend flour at NO interest, just to see their faces. Don't you dare tell anyone I said that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Honestly? Dying with full pockets and an empty table. What was I saving it all FOR, then? ...Forget the second part.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: I ran the numbers, %1$s. Time with you: costly. Returns: unreasonable. You're the one thing I'd overpay for. Don't quote me.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: That information isn't for sale yet — and I sell almost everything. Build some credit with me first. You're good for it, I think.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Ha — that one's in the locked chest under the locked chest. Keep investing, %1$s. You're the rare account I hope matures.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing worth trading. A quiet week — bad for gossip, worse for business. Even the chickens are withholding.
dialogue.chat: A conversation, free of charge? Consider it an investment in us, %1$s. Proceed.
